Control_Text: Staff sign in with a personal account and a second factor before reaching shared systems.
Laptops and phones lock automatically after a short idle period and keep their disks encrypted.
Nightly copies of important files are kept in a separate location and restored as a test every quarter.
Suspected security incidents are reported to a named contact and handled by a written playbook.
New suppliers are reviewed before they receive company data and are reviewed again every year.
Office doors open only with a badge and visitors are signed in and escorted.
Software changes are reviewed by a second developer and tested before release.
Employees complete a short awareness course when they join and once a year after that.
